cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --x 110 --sy '70*2' --sh '50*3' --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --top_edge e --retainer 15 --retainer_hole_edge 1 --thickness 4 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageShelf --x --sy --sh --outside --retainer --retainer_hole_edge --thickness --burn --reference --labels
